content:
Stepping onto the other side of the courtroom table for the very first time was an unforgettable experience! ✨

On 12th September 2026, I had an absolute pleasure serving as a judge for Preliminary Rounds 1 & 2 at The Amikus Qriae's 5th Annual Virtual Moot Court Competition 2026!

What made this milestone especially exciting for me was the moot proposition. It tackled complex, contemporary legal challenges right at the intersection of Data Privacy, Criminal Law, and Constitutional Guarantees. It was so refreshing to witness the sheer energy, sharp analytical skills, and poise the participants brought to their arguments. Engaging with such bright, enthusiastic law students and sharing feedback was easily the highlight of my month! 

A big thank you to the organizing team at The Amikus Qriae for the warm invitation and this lovely Letter of Appreciation. Wishing all the participating teams the absolute best in their legal journeys!
